chunks: And from him, from Ayoub ibn Nuh, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf, who said: Abu Basir narrated to me from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The fasting person should not use siwak (tooth-stick) with a fresh (moist) twig."

key_terms.يَسْتَاكُ: Uses siwak / cleanses teeth with siwak

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on using siwak while fasting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadi’ (AS) distinguishing between fresh and dry siwak, reflecting the juristic debate on whether the moisture of a fresh twig constitutes 'eating' or 'drinking' when it reaches the throat. This specific constraint highlights the Shia emphasis on precaution (*ihtiyat*) in preserving the integrity of the fast, contrasting with other schools that may permit siwak generally.
